description: RoboCop patrols Delta City with Detective Madigan as OCP technology, corporate schemes and increasingly strange crimes collide with the surviving relationships and memories of Alex Murphy's human life.

s01e01-02.description: RoboCop and Detective Madigan uncover a scheme to place Delta City's infrastructure under the control of a human-linked supercomputer, drawing them into an OCP conspiracy built around the NeuroBrain project.

s01e03.description: RoboCop is framed for the murder of a televangelist with his own weapon and refuses to reveal the personal alibi that could clear him, leaving his survival to the evidence Madigan can uncover.

s01e04.description: OCP rushes a supposedly miraculous drug into Delta City before proper testing, and RoboCop investigates after its mind-altering effects trigger violent behavior and place Madigan under suspicion.

s01e05.description: RoboCop takes the OCP Chairman into neglected Old Detroit, where street violence, corporate indifference and a badly damaged RoboCop force an unlikely alliance with a family desperate to save their child.

s01e06.description: A critically ill boy needs a lung transplant, but black-market organ thieves steal the donor lungs, sending RoboCop after a trafficking operation before the child runs out of time.

s01e07.description: War veterans armed with stolen advanced weaponry threaten Delta City, and RoboCop discovers that one of the mercenaries is tied to his own childhood and to buried secrets from a military operation.

s01e08.description: OCP empowers a neighborhood patrol to fight a new narcotic in Old Detroit, only for RoboCop to discover the patrol is protecting the dealers and recruiting his own son.

s01e09.description: RoboCop's estranged family becomes trapped in OCP's privatized welfare system, forcing him to choose between enforcing Provision Twenty Two and exposing a program that punishes protest with forced reconditioning.

s01e10.description: A new OCP treatment can temporarily give anyone another face, and Pudface Morgan turns the technology into a weapon for escape, murder and impersonation that threatens RoboCop's family.

s01e11.description: RoboCop and Madigan protect a ruthless corporate raider while discovering that the takeover of a rocket-fuel developer has placed an upcoming space launch and its crew in mortal danger.

s01e12.description: A bomber targets OCP with escalating attacks, bringing RoboCop into an uneasy partnership with his retired-police-captain father, who does not know the machine beside him is his son Alex Murphy.

s01e13.description: OCP turns crime into prime-time entertainment with a reality program following criminals, giving Pudface Morgan the perfect stage for a live confrontation with RoboCop.

s01e14.description: Children begin stealing and rioting under the influence of OCP's cheerful Commander Cash mascot, leading RoboCop to a man who has decided the corporate superhero should exist in the real world.

s01e15.description: RoboCop protects the OCP Chairman from an assassin while Madigan becomes involved with a charismatic magician whose illusions may conceal a connection to the murder plot.

s01e16.description: A technologically equipped vigilante attacks criminal gangs across Delta City, and RoboCop discovers the masked campaign is connected to a former partner from Alex Murphy's past.

s01e17.description: The OCP Chairman is kidnapped after provoking a militant women's group, while RoboCop and Madigan untangle the abduction from a separate plan to exploit the chaos inside OCP.

s01e18.description: Lippencott falls for Diana inside virtual reality while a kidnapper uses Nancy Murphy to blackmail RoboCop into stealing an experimental weapon capable of killing through the heart.

s01e19.description: Gadget leaves Sergeant Parks to reunite with her biological mother, but RoboCop suspects the reunion is being manipulated by Russian crime boss Stitch Molotov and his partner Nadia.

s01e20.description: Madigan is seriously injured in a seemingly impossible traffic accident, and RoboCop traces a series of machine-controlled crimes to microscopic robots that can override electronics and vehicles.

s01e21.description: Anti-corporate attacks shake Delta City as RoboCop and Madigan pursue a former terrorist, only to uncover a corrupt union scheme using the unrest for its own purposes.

s01e22.description: RoboCop and Madigan race against a televised execution to prove that the condemned man is innocent before the program's countdown reaches its deliberately public conclusion.

s01e23.description: Several of RoboCop's most persistent enemies join forces around a presidential visit to OCP, turning the ceremony into an assassination plot designed to make RoboCop himself part of the attack.
